name: WhoisXML API
description:
The WhoisXML API MCP server brings WhoisXML's full data catalog into Claude. Investigate suspicious domains, map subdomain footprints, look up IP geolocation, query historical WHOIS records, and check threat intelligence — all from a chat session.

Tool surface: WHOIS, Domain Availability, Domain Reputation, Categorization, IP Geolocation, IP Netblocks, Reverse IP, DNS Lookup, Subdomains, WHOIS History, Reverse WHOIS, threat intelligence, and more — 32 read-only tools backed by WhoisXML API.

Built by WhoisXML API — domain, IP, and DNS intelligence provider since 2010. Connect with your WhoisXML API key via OAuth; usage is billed against your own WhoisXML account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WhoisXML API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WhoisXML API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-hosted.whoisxmlapi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WhoisXML API MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WhoisXML API lists 32 MCP tools, including brand_alert, bulk_dns_lookup, bulk_email_verification, bulk_ip_geolocation, bulk_job_results, bulk_job_status, bulk_subdomain_lookup, bulk_whois, categorization, disposable_email_check, dns_history, and dns_lookup.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WhoisXML API?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to WhoisXML API in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does WhoisXML API MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: WhoisXML API requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WhoisXML API is developed by Whois API, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
